target.title: fix: iOS Talk fallback settings opens Voice & Talk
target.body:
Closes #98593

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who hit the iOS Talk fallback banner would tap "Open Settings" and land on Settings / Gateway instead of the Voice & Talk settings page.

## Why This Change Was Made

Talk-specific settings actions now have a separate Voice settings route, while gateway/offline repair actions continue to open Gateway settings. This keeps the fallback banner, details sheet, Voice mode card, and Voice & Talk controls pointed at the relevant settings page without changing Talk runtime behavior.

## User Impact

Users who see the iOS Speech fallback banner can go directly to Voice & Talk settings instead of hunting through the Settings root or Gateway page.

## Evidence

- Created/linked issue: #98593
- `swiftlint lint apps/ios/Sources/Design/TalkProTab.swift --quiet --strict --config apps/ios/.swiftlint.yml`
- `swiftlint lint apps/ios/Sources/RootTabs.swift --quiet --strict --config apps/ios/.swiftlint.yml`
- `git diff --check`
- `xcodebuild test -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17,OS=26.5' -only-testing:OpenClawTests/RootTabsSourceGuardTests -only-testing:OpenClawTests/RootTabsPresentationTests` passed 77 Swift Testing tests.
- `codex review --base origin/main` found no concrete regression after generated Xcode package-resolution churn was restored.

No screenshot is attached because the change is a navigation target for an existing button; the focused source guard verifies Talk-specific settings actions route to SettingsRoute.voice while gateway actions remain on Gateway.
